_: Teknesyum Neon — the single source of truth for theme tokens.
Edit this file, then run `node ui/scripts/generate.js`; theme.css, Theme.xaml,
Theme.axaml and Palette.cs are generated from it. Never edit a generated file
by hand: the next run produces a diff and test/u11-tema.js fails.
New theme: copy this file as theme.<name>.tokens.json and fill it in, then run
`node ui/scripts/generate.js theme.<name>.tokens.json`. One file, one command.
Derived values are declarative (ref + alpha); the derivation rules (alpha byte,
gradient stops, platform formats) live in generate.js.

meta.name: neon
meta.rationale: The public standard is plain: black, white and grey, no glow, no tuned values. It is dark only — until a second theme is defined (SKILL §1).

renk-1.rationale: Primary brand colour: primary button fill, heading, label, focus ring.

renk-2.rationale: The FILL cut of the secondary brand colour; as text it gives 10.00:1, so text work goes to renk-2-text.

renk-3.rationale: Tertiary brand colour: decoration, scrollbar, ghost button.

renk-2-text.rationale: The TEXT cut of renk-2: 10.26:1 on #000000, clears §2's 7:1 threshold.

renk-3-text.rationale: The TEXT cut of renk-3; the fill renk-3 does not clear the 7:1 text threshold.

surface.rationale: The dark end of the background and the panel base; every contrast measurement is against this ground.

black.rationale: The opening end of the background gradient and the inner layer of the focus ring.

glass-base.rationale: The base colour of the glass surface; never used alone, it lives through the glass derivation.

success.rationale: Success role; it has no counterpart in the brand triad and carries its own hex. Renamed from NeonSuccess to a role on 2026-08-23.

danger.rationale: A role follows the brand's VALUE, not a copy of it; danger fill and danger button.

danger-text.rationale: Error text writes the text renk-2, not the fill renk-2 — the 7:1 threshold (10.26:1).

warning.rationale: WARNING SURFACE ONLY: text (14.58:1), border, icon. No fill, no button — white text on this fill is 1.80:1. The hex is subject to the U9 ΔE measurement.

warning-border.rationale: 3.96:1 on #000000 — clears 1.4.11's 3:1 threshold; renk-2 /50 (3.02) and renk-3 /50 (3.01) did not.

text.rationale: Body text. No mid greys; for secondary text the answer is not grey, it is deleting the text (SKILL §2).

text-label.rationale: Label and h3 colour; bound to renk-1, not a copy of it.

disabled.rationale: The only colour exempt from 7:1 (SKILL §2); never used alone — title/ToolTip is mandatory, plus a cursor and, where possible, an icon.

panel.rationale: Panel background; the XAML Surface brush and .tk-panel take the same value from here.

glass.rationale: Glass surface (dark-glass); title bar and translucent layers.

border-decorative.rationale: Decorative rule; carries no information, outside the scope of 1.4.11.

tone-scale.rationale: XAML/Avalonia has no var(); alpha cuts are generated as named brushes.

text-scale.rationale: Translucent brushes for the text cuts.

glow.rationale: Box glow, off in the plain standard (alpha 0); text is never given a glow, the sole exception being hero (SKILL §2).

glow-hero.rationale: Off in the plain standard (alpha 0); a theme turns the hero glow on by raising alpha, blur 8 on both platforms.

glow-button.rationale: Primary button halo, off in the plain standard (alpha 0); in BoxShadow opacity is the colour alpha (alpha × 255).

shadow-panel.rationale: Panel drop shadow; separates the panel from the background gradient without a second border (components.md Panel).

scrim.rationale: Modal scrim (forms.md §3); the same value on both platforms (#99000000).

bg-gradient.rationale: Not a flat colour but an 11-stop gradient (SKILL §2); the stops are linearly interpolated in the script, which closes banding.

scrollbar-thumb.rationale: Scrollbar thumb and its hover colour. No glow: a halo on a thin moving bar smears.

_: Which text colour sits on each fill. on names an existing colour; null means the fill carries no text.
generate.js composites a translucent fill over surface, measures the pair and refuses to generate below 7:1.

renk-1-60.rationale: Carries no text: the best pair, text on renk-1 60% over surface, is 5.36:1, below 7:1.

renk-2-50.rationale: Carries no text: the best pair, text on renk-2 50% over surface, is 6.96:1, below 7:1.

renk-2-60.rationale: Carries no text: the best pair, text on renk-2 60% over surface, is 5.31:1, below 7:1.

renk-3-50.rationale: Carries no text: the best pair, text on renk-3 50% over surface, is 6.97:1, below 7:1.

renk-3-60.rationale: Carries no text: the best pair, text on renk-3 60% over surface, is 5.31:1, below 7:1.

bg-rotate.rationale: Background rotation — the one named exception to the infinite-loop ban (SKILL §5.4).

spring.rationale: Emphasis spring; used on the web side only.

in-out.rationale: Slow start, fast middle, slow end: an element moving from one place to another on screen.

fast-slow-fast.rationale: Fast start, slow middle, fast end: a pass that lingers on the midpoint, such as a carousel step or a highlight sweep.

emphasized.rationale: Snaps in and settles long: large panels and modals entering; the frame after the input already moves.

sharp.rationale: Short symmetric curve for elements that may return at any moment, such as a drawer or a tooltip.

linear.rationale: Constant speed: only for progress, spinners and colour fades, never for movement.

fs-1.rationale: Type scale step 1 — label, hint, h3. The floor: no text below 14 (SKILL §3).

fs-5.rationale: Hero number; 32 sets the hero clear of fs-4 (readability pass, 2026-09-25). Do not add an intermediate step.

lh-heading.rationale: Heading, label, hero and button line height.

measure.rationale: Maximum readable line length for a prose block (SKILL §3).

tr-label.rationale: Label tracking; the widest cut, it separates a label from an h3 at the same size.

tr-hero.rationale: Hero tracking; the only negative cut, large mono digits fall apart without it.

fw-body.rationale: Body weight. 700 is forbidden outside hero (SKILL §3).

fw-semi.rationale: h2, h3, label and mono weight.

1.rationale: Spacing ladder step 1; also the menu and tooltip entry offset.

2.rationale: Step 2: field inner gap, tab gap, panel entry offset.

3.rationale: Step 3: row gap, toast stack gap, input horizontal padding.

5.rationale: Step 5: panel padding, section gap, glow clearance.

panel-padding.rationale: Panel inner padding (SKILL §5); the ladder value, not a separate measurement.

field-gap.rationale: Gap between a field's label, control and help text (forms.md §1).

toast-inset.rationale: Toast distance from the viewport edge (forms.md §4).

r.rationale: The single radius (SKILL §5, layout.md §5.1). The exception is the circle: badge, slider thumb, status dot.

r-window.rationale: Window shell radius, drawn title bar included (desktop.md §10).

border-w.rationale: Default border width; the tab outline sits 1 DIP inset with the same width.

window-edge.rationale: Window shell outline colour; none draws no edge.

focus-w.rationale: Focus ring outline width; the inner layer is black (SKILL §5.3).

focus-offset.rationale: Focus ring offset. The ring never animates.

target-min.rationale: Minimum interactive target, 24×24 DIP (SKILL §5.3); the checkbox cell takes the same value.

scrollbar-style.rationale: Scrollbar look: solid, thin, pill, hover, fade or shrink.

scroll-behavior.rationale: Programmatic scroll: auto or smooth. Reduced motion forces auto.

titlebar-h-max.rationale: Drawn title bar ceiling; the source gives a range, not one number.

modal-w.rationale: Modal width: 560, capped at 90% of the viewport (forms.md §3).

installer-w.rationale: Installer window width; every installer takes the same window (AmeliyatListe reference).

modal-max-ratio.rationale: Modal maximum height as a share of the viewport.

toast-w.rationale: Toast width: 360, capped at the viewport minus one inset per side (forms.md §4).

toast-max.rationale: Maximum toasts visible at once; the stack cap is enforced by the scanner.

toast-life.rationale: Toast life. Danger toasts never auto-dismiss; hover and focus pause the timer.

icon-1.rationale: Smallest icon, inline with label text (components.md).

scale-hover.rationale: Hover scale; the signature block uses the same value — hover is never carried by opacity (SKILL §5).

entry-offset.rationale: Entry animation offset for panels and lists (SKILL §5.4).

overlay-offset.rationale: Menu and tooltip entry offset; smaller, because they open next to the pointer.

stagger.rationale: List stagger step; empty to filled uses the same step (motion.md M8).

stagger-max.rationale: Maximum staggered items; beyond this the list enters as one block.

glow-margin.rationale: Clear space an outward glow needs; without it use a /50 border instead (motion.md M15).

loading-loop-min.rationale: Loading loop floor; a faster loop reads as an error (motion.md M2).

frame-budget.rationale: Frame budget at the 95th percentile (motion.md M15).

bg-rotate-min.rationale: Background rotation floor; the shipped value is duration.bg-rotate (motion.md M10).

bg-sweep-max.rationale: Background gradient angle sweep ceiling; the CSS keyframe runs 150 to 170.

sans.rationale: The chain's only source is SKILL §3; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is embedded in the project, not assumed present on the system.

mono.rationale: Every number, key and piece of code is written in mono (SKILL §3).

label._: Every piece of chrome text the apps share: the words (tr, en) and their look (colour ref, size step, weight step). The preview edits them; setup writes labels.tr.json and labels.en.json next to each target so every app reads the same words.

brand.rationale: Signature brand chip; colour and weight match the titlebar chip.

support.rationale: Support chip; renk-3-text as in the titlebar support chip.

site.rationale: Site chip beside the support chip.

update.download-tr: Yeni sürüm var, indirmek için tıklayın
update.download-en: New version available, click to download
update.rationale: Two-step update badge: the label and the hint for each step.

sync.rationale: Sync badge states; the state colour comes from the role tokens.

title.rationale: Window title: the app name, its accent part and their look.
